senses.gloss:
षट् षट्, षड्, for षष्, at the beginning
of comps. See षष्.

षाट् षाट्, ind. a vocative particle or inter-
jection of calling (according to some).

सट् सट्, cl. 1. P. सटति, ससाट, सटितुम्,
to be a part or portion; cl. 10. P. साट-
यति, -यितुम्, (not to be distinguished fr. rt. साट्),
to manifest, show.

साट् साट्, cl. 10. P. साटयति, -यितुम्, to
make visible or manifest, show.

शट, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt. शट् above),
sour, astringent, acid.

शटा शटा, f. (= सटा, जटा), an ascetic's
clotted hair.

शाट शाट, अस्, m. (fr. rt. शट्), a petticoat;
a particular clean or white garment, gown; cloth.

सट सट, अम्, आ, n. f. (= जटा, शटा; ac-
cording to some also अस्, m.), an ascetic's matted or
clotted hair, the hair collected into a loose braid and
twisted forwards upon the forehead, a braid of hair
(in general); the mane (of a lion &c.); the bristles
(of a boar); a crest, (in these last three senses usually
आ, f.)
—सटाङ्क (˚टा-अङ्˚), अस्, m. ‘mane-marked,’
a lion.
—सटा-पाटल, अस्, m. the red mane (of a
lion).

शटि, इस्, f. the plant called Zedoary or Curcuma
Amhaldi (otherwise Curcuma Zerumbet; there are
thirty-eight synonyms of this plant; cf. गन्धा,
गन्ध-मूली, &c.); a particular kind of ginger (the
fresh root of which is scented like a green mango).
शटी, f. = शटि above.
शाटी, f. = शाट above.

सटि सटि, इस्, f. (= शटि), the plant called
zedoary or a kind of Curcuma.
सटी, f. = सटि above; a kind of perfume.

शट्टक शट्टक, अम्, n. flour of rice mixed
with water and ghee.

शाटक, अस्, अम्, m. n. a petticoat, garment, cloth; a
kind of play (= नाटक, according to Śabda-k.).

सट्टक सट्टक, अम्, n. a sort of minor
drama (in Prākṛt).
शाटिका, f. a particular plant, the Zedoary (= शटी).
सटिका, f. = सटि, सटी.

सटीक स-टीक, अस्, आ, अम्, accompanied by a
comment or exposition, explained by a commentary.

शाट्यायन शाट्यायन, अस्, m., N. of a Muni;
(अम्), n., N. of a Brāhmaṇa; a particular oblation
for remedying anything wrong in the performance
of an act or rite; (अस्, ई, अम्), of or belonging to
Śāṭyāyana or to the Śāṭyāyana-Brāhmaṇa.
—शाट्या-
यन-होम, अस्, m. the above oblation.

शाट्यायनक, अम्, n. a passage from the Śāṭyā-
yana-Brāhmaṇa.

शाट्यायनि, इस्, m., N. of the author of a law-
book.

शाट्यायनिन्, इनस्, m. pl. the followers of the
Śāṭyāyana-Brāhmaṇa; N. of a Śākhā belonging to
the Yajur-veda.

षट्क, अस्, आ, अम्, having six, sixfold, six; (अम्),
n. an aggregate of six.

षाट्कौशिक षाट्कौशिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. षट्-
कोश), enveloped in six sheathes.

षाट्पौरुषिक षाट्पौरुषिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr.
षष् + पुरुष), relating or belonging to six
generations.

सटङ्कार स-टङ्कार, अस्, आ, अम्, having
notoriety or fame, famous.

सट्वा सट्वा, f. a kind of bird; a musical
instrument (= वाद्य).

साटोप साटोप (स-आट्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having a
swelling, swollen, puffed up; puffed up with pride,
proud, haughty, consequential; (अम्), ind. arrogantly,
proudly, consequentially.

साट्टहास साट्टहास (स-अट्˚), अम्, ind. with
loud laughter, with a horse-laugh.
